decisions.reason: Confirming the authoritative final file does not change the existing constraint that the unintended newline marker must be absent from the title.
The final-file confirmation does not modify any copyediting, sentence-clarity, meaning-preservation, or punctuation constraint.
The confirmed file concerns the manuscript working file and does not resolve or change the separate cover-design choices.
Designating a final manuscript file does not change the requirement to provide back matter and author lines.
The source does not change the requirements concerning image distortion, cropping, or pixelation.
Final-file confirmation does not entail that pagination or table-of-contents page-number requirements changed or were completed.
The choice of an authoritative manuscript file does not alter the requested publishing-process, prerequisite, or copyright guidance.
The source does not change which chapter images are permitted, supplied, or subject to suitability review.
Confirming the final manuscript file does not remove or modify the requested review of table-of-contents typography.
The final-file designation does not change chapter-image coverage, placement, presentation, or reference rules.
The source does not explicitly resume, remove, or otherwise change the deferred paragraph-spacing requirement.
The authoritative-file change leaves the italic styling and quotation-mark treatment requirements unchanged.
